Profile/account/preferences

/app/account
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: P44

Manage personal presentation and display preferences while identifying institution-managed identity. Keep sign-in sessions, delivery settings and academic roles distinct.

Permissions
  • User edits own preferences only; role assignment remains read-only.
  • Photo review does not imply immediate institution identity change.
  • Session facts are account-private and not available to course staff.
Responsive
  • Profile and security panels stack; destructive actions stay separated.
  • Larger text reflows labels and buttons without clipped values.
Accessibility
  • Managed values use readable text rather than faded disabled inputs.
  • Photo chooser has file alternatives and preview description; motion respects reduced-motion settings.
Data
  • Editable preference fixture; managed identity source facts.
  • Photo proposal/review status and session summaries without secret tokens.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Blank pronouns save successfully without being treated as missing.
  • Changing timezone preserves event instants while changing display labels.
  • Failed session termination remains unconfirmed and cannot claim access was revoked.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
